title: Figure 1: Ignition with 10^7-ampere GeV proton beam - 'Solution in between two extremes'
description: Slide-style figure titled 'Solution in between two extremes' and captioned 'Figure 1. Ignition With 10^7-Ampere GeV Proton Beam (Reference 16)'. Three panels compare 'Centurion - Halite (DT Pellets)' (E >= 10^6 J), 'Mike Test (Teller/Ulam Configuration)' (E >= 10^12 J) and 'Hypothetical D-D Ignition with Super Marx Generator' (E <= 10^9 J, I >= 10^7 A), each with energy and density-radius thresholds. Surrounding text discusses nonfission ignition of thermonuclear microexplosions for propulsion.
